cases.title: SkillsBridge — Work-Evidence to HR Skill Attribution Console
cases.persona: HR Capability Lead & Team Engineering Manager
cases.businessProblem: Northstar has work evidence scattered across resolved IT incidents and incomplete HR skill profiles. Automatic AI attribution risks assigning unverified skills and eroding employee trust. We need a human-in-the-loop review workspace where reviewers inspect incident evidence alongside fixed ESCO skill references, approve or reject the current revision, suppress duplicate syncs, and recover cleanly from HR destination 429/503 outages.

cases.title: QuayReady — Inbound Container & Berth Exception Triage Engine
cases.persona: Terminal Operations Dispatcher & Warehouse Intake Coordinator
cases.businessProblem: Warehouse and quay operators currently track incoming containers, customs holds, and seal discrepancies across fragmented spreadsheets and email threads. Delays and damaged seals are reported too late, causing demurrage penalties and unsafe gate handovers. We need a unified exception desk to register incoming containers, track ETA delays, report physical/customs anomalies, and trigger SLA escalations.

cases.title: Auditly Studio — Enterprise AI UX Audit & Design System Governance Hub
cases.persona: AI Product Manager & Principal UX Architect
cases.businessProblem: Enterprise teams rapidly generate AI prototypes across multiple products, but ship inconsistent styling, poor contrast, missing error states, and unverified business requirements. We need an AI UX Audit & Redesign Governance Hub that evaluates screens against WCAG 2.1 AA, verifies 100% requirement traceability, coordinates 4 Magic Patterns inspiration variants, and enforces human sign-off before React code export.

archetypes.name: Split Operations Canvas
archetypes.directionThesis: Two-column master-detail split canvas: left queue with live status segmentation; right sticky inspection & human sign-off drawer so reviewers never lose list context.

archetypes.name: Progressive Triage Feed
archetypes.directionThesis: Focused single-column progressive disclosure feed with inline expandable evidence cards, keyboard shortcut pills (J/K/A/R), and zero modal interruptions.

archetypes.name: High-Density Operations Matrix
archetypes.directionThesis: Compact tabular command matrix optimized for high-volume dispatchers: monospace revision hashes, inline SLA badges, and batch idempotent retry bar.

archetypes.name: Guided 4-Step Verification Wizard
archetypes.directionThesis: Stepped verification rail (1. Evidence Check → 2. Identity & Vocabulary Match → 3. Human Decision → 4. Idempotent Sync Receipt) reducing cognitive load for new reviewers.

rubric.note: Self-assessed engineering & product design rubric (Section 8) backed by executable repository checks — not an official Magic Patterns exam score.

categories.evidence: 4 divergent Magic Patterns inspiration variants (A/B/C/D) + interactive/empty/loading/error state simulation.
Northstar Enterprise Design System tokens resolved to concrete hex, radii (10px/6px), and typography scales.
Structured FR/NFR specifications, Gherkin user stories, Mermaid process flow, and Traceability Matrix.
Magic Patterns MCP configured across Claude Code, Codex (OAuth active), Cursor, VS Code, Copilot & Antigravity + 6 official agent skills.
Automated 7-dimension UX evaluator + mathematical WCAG 2.1 AA contrast verification + UAT test plan.
Runnable Studio Workbench, CLI (`magic-patterns`), seed bundles, and honest evidence-first documentation.
